QUOTE: The intended checks are Valgrind memcheck (`components-configuration-crypto.sh`, with `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`) and MemSan (`components-sanitizers.sh`, C path only). Both are taint-style checks for secret-dependent branches and addresses on the tested paths.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names Valgrind/MemSan test checks, but it never says this is a separate, off-by-default testing facility or that it is explicitly not part of the library API, so the item's full claim is absent.
